name: Kujigawa Karen
source:
Roommate. Natsuki's age.

The bright and cheerful mood-maker. Although her appearance is distinctly foreign, she was born and raised in Japan and is fluent and accustomed to the language and culture. Sometimes jokes around by pretending to be an ignorant tourist.

She greatly enjoys physical contact, and often clings to Natsuki. She also has a pet flying squirrel named Suu-san.

[translated from Getchu]
